ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupy the outer lateral lobes. A central black pigmentation region extends from the peduncle attachment to the median notch. A continuous, irregular black border of varying thickness (10-30 pixels) follows the trailing edge. A distinct circular black focal spot is located in the upper-mid region of the left lobe's white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge; amplitude of serrations increases significantly toward the distal tips, characterized by jagged pixel transitions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly symmetrical convex curve extending from the central peduncle to the lateral tips, with a slight recurve on the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity, raised circular pixel groups (white) at the far left tip, indicating sessile organism attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible: three parallel vertical marks on the lower left lobe and two shorter diagonal marks on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular indentation or 'chunk' missing from the inner trailing edge of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular spot situated in the upper-left quadrant of the white pigmentation field.
